name: Kasawari gas field development and CCS project (Block SK316, offshore Sarawak)
location: Kasawari field, Block SK316, offshore Sarawak, Malaysia
description: 3.3 Mtpa CO2 reinjection — Malaysia's first large-scale CCS project. The Kasawari gas field began production in August 2024; CO2 injection had not started as of April 2026 — PETRONAS said on 1 April 2026 it is looking to bring the first injection forward to as early as 2027, from a previous projection of end-2029/early 2030

capacities.basis: FID announcement (Oil & Gas Journal); injection timeline per The Star, 1 April 2026
